title: mCSQA: Multilingual Commonsense Reasoning Dataset with Unified Creation Strategy by Language Models and Humans

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuned accuracy of various multilingual language models across eight distinct languages (English, Japanese, Chinese, German, Portuguese, Dutch, French, Russian) using the mCSQA benchmark to identify performance disparities and limits in cross-lingual transfer capabilities.

Comparing model performance on language-specific commonsense questions that require deep, localized cultural knowledge ('Hard' sets) versus more easily translated general knowledge ('Easy' sets) to expose models' over-reliance on the cultural norms and backgrounds of their primary source languages (e.g., English).
